coach.name: Chris Capko
coach.notes: First-year head coach, hired March 2026 (ESPN reported the hire March 20, 2026; AP/WTOP: named two days after SMU's NCAA Tournament loss). Replaced Michael Lewis, fired March 7, 2026 after a 12-19 (7-11 MAC) season in which Ball State missed the MAC Tournament for a third straight year on a tiebreaker. Capko was SMU associate head coach 2024-26 under Andy Enfield; USC assistant 2016-24 (and director of basketball operations 2013-15); earlier stops at FIU, Georgia Southern, Stetson and Marshall. Played at Florida (walk-on) and South Florida (started 23 games at point guard 2005-06). Record as Ball State HC: 0-2 (lost 67-55 at Georgia Southern Nov 2 and 69-66 vs. Indiana State Nov 6, 2026). Contract terms not found in sources read.

previews.title: 2026-27 Mid-American Conference men's basketball season
previews.summary: Ball State was picked 11th in the Oct 20, 2026 MAC preseason coaches poll with 40 points, ahead of only Central Michigan (25). Chris Capko is listed as a first-year head coach (0-0) after Michael Lewis was fired March 7, 2026 following a 12-19 season; Capko, SMU's associate head coach, was hired in March 2026. The page notes Babatunde Durodola was featured in the league's preseason preview. No Ball State player made the preseason All-MAC first or second team.

player_claims.claim: Featured as Ball State's representative in the MAC preseason preview materials.

previews.title: 2026-27 Mid-American Men's Basketball Overview
previews.author: Foster Roesti (Ball State section)
previews.summary: Ball State went 12-19 (7-11 MAC) in 2025-26 and missed the MAC Tournament for a third straight year after losing a tiebreaker for the final spot. First-year coach Chris Capko (ex-SMU associate head coach) brings a new staff and playing style; the piece calls the frontcourt unproven but labels Ball State a possible 'wildcard' that could create chaos in the MAC. The rebuilt roster is transfer-heavy: K'Jei Parker (UMass), Javion Guy-King (Central Arkansas), Babatunde Durodola (Temple), Trey Lewis (Western Michigan), Jaden Smith (Saint Joseph's), plus Zaon Collins and Kijani Wright. Departures: Preston Copeland (Miami OH), Armoni Ziegler (Boston College), Davion Hill (San Diego), Kayden Fish (Belmont); Elmore James IV and Devon Barnes graduated. Non-conference tests at SMU (Nov 13) and Florida State (Nov 17).

previews.author: Ball State Athletics
previews.summary: Schedule release for Capko's first season: exhibitions at Purdue (Oct 18) and vs. Purdue Fort Wayne (Oct 28); opener at Georgia Southern Nov 2 (MAC-SBC Challenge); home games vs. Indiana State (Nov 6) and Brescia (Nov 9); road trips to SMU (Nov 13, Capko's former school), Florida State (Nov 17) and Southern Indiana (Nov 28); Evansville (Dec 9) and East-West University (Dec 29) at home; MAC-SBC Challenge round two Feb 6. Capko: 'We're really excited about our non-conference schedule and the different challenges it presents,' saying he wants the team to challenge itself, learn about itself and grow before MAC play. No roster details.

storylines.headline: Capko era opens 0-2 after Georgia Southern and Indiana State losses
storylines.detail: Ball State lost 67-55 at Georgia Southern on Nov 2 (Javion Guy-King 12 pts) and then blew a double-digit second-half lead in a 69-66 home loss to Indiana State on Nov 6.

storylines.headline: Near-total roster rebuild through the portal
storylines.detail: At least eight transfers signed in April-May 2026 (Parker, Fine, Guy-King, Smith, Lewis, Durodola, Henderson Jr., Blake) plus freshmen McGilveary and McGrew; Copeland, Ziegler, Hill and Fish left. The official 14-man roster lists players from UMass, Western Michigan, Central Arkansas, Purdue, Texas Tech, Saint Joseph's, Temple, Vermont and Kentucky.
